verdicts.note: FY2024 press release copies: revenue $3,602.0M (+29%), bookings $4,369.1M (+24%), avg DAU 82.9M (+21%), net loss to common $935.4M (consolidated $940.6M); CEO on Q4 call: 'over $922,000,000' shared with developers. ~1.04M daily paying users not in extracts (prior knowledge). Bonus: FY2024 hours engaged 73.5B.

H1 2024 $448.0M confirmed. EDGAR-derived table gives the full-year line as ~$915M for FY2024 (FY2023 ~$878M, FY2025 ~$1,153M), so 'roughly $0.9B' stands; precise value ~$915M -> ~$0.92/DAU/month and ~1.24c per engaged hour (73.5B hours). The 'Q4 13% of revenue / 9% of bookings' wording was not in extracts.

Q4 2025: revenue $1.415B (+43%), bookings $2.222B (+63%), DAU 144M (+69%), hours 35B (+88%), DevEx $477M (+70%), ~37M monthly payers, net loss $318M, FCF $307M; 2026 bookings guidance $8.28-8.55B (22-26%), revenue $6.02-6.29B. Full-year ~$4.9B/~$6.8B and top-1,000 $1.3M average not quoted in extracts but consistent. Extract ties DevEx growth to an '8.5% DevEx rate increase announced Sept 2025' (= $0.0035->$0.0038).

1 Nov 2025 formula change, 75% six-month acquisition bonus and ~74%-of-cash figure confirmed from Epic's post. Corrections: Epic extended the 100% V-Bucks-value share through 31 Jan 2027 (50% from 1 Feb 2027), not 'through 2026'; publishing for in-island transactions opened 9 Jan 2026, not Dec 2025. 40%-of-net pool size not in extracts (prior knowledge). Also: 50% of Sponsored Row revenue goes to the pool.

From 15 June 2026: Full Region 20K $209->$199, Full Region w/ Land Capacity Bonus $239->$209; Homestead/OpenSpace/Mainland unchanged. From 8 July 2026: Premium $11.99->$12.99/mo, $99->$119.88/yr, quarterly $32.97->$35.97; Premium Plus annual $249->$287.88. LindeX min buy fee $1.49->$0.49; percentage fee reportedly 10%->11%. Linden's own post unreachable (fetch blocked); blog reproduction used.

Dec 2024 VentureBeat disclosure by Oberwager/Rosedale relayed by kowatek and modemworld: >$1.3B spent over 20 years, ~$1.1B paid to creators since 2003, ~$650M/yr economy, 90/10 share. $78M for 2023 rests on one secondhand summary. Company-provided, not independently verified; one outlet misreads $1.1B as a single-year figure.

28 Aug 2025 CEO post: ~70c kept per $1 first-party item vs ~30c per $1 UGC after 30% platform fees; runway into 2029; ~50% layoff (after a 16% cut in March 2025; staff ~310 -> just over 100). Shutdown 1 June 2026 noon PT; >150M lifetime players; $3.5B valuation from a single outlet; $294M raised not in extracts (prior knowledge). New: Snap reportedly acquired select assets/talent.

FAQ/payout pages: 1 credit ≈ $0.005 at payout, 30,000 earned-credit minimum, once per day via Tilia to PayPal, 1.5% fee; VRChat's welcome page states ~50% creator / ~30% store platform / ~20% VRChat+Tilia. Layoff announced 12 June 2024, ~30%. Caveats: Program Rules say $100 minimum and one request per two weeks (conflict); processor now 'Thunes, formerly Tilia'. $0.0083 per purchased credit not in extracts.

RL FY2025 revenue ~$2.21B, operating loss $19.19B (FY2024 $17.73B); cumulative $83.6B losses since 2020. Horizon VR end-of-support (15 June 2026) announced 17-18 March 2026, reversed ~20 March. Nuance: reversal is partial - only legacy Unity-engine worlds stay in VR; Horizon Engine worlds are flatscreen/mobile-only and no new VR content is planned.

Confirmed: >half of ~250 staff cut late Aug 2025 (Animoca confirmed restructuring), Robby Yung named CEO (CoinDesk says Yat Siu oversees - unsettled), co-founders sidelined, 'a few hundred DAU, mostly bots' per unnamed sources, SAND $8.40 -> ~$0.28 (-97%). NOT found: the $450,000 estate now worth ~$1,025 - no extract mentions it (nearest: Naavik's 2021 ~$472k-per-MAU valuation note). Treat the estate anecdote as unverified.

additional_findings: Roblox FY2024 hours engaged were 73.5B (+23%), confirming the researcher's unsearched ~73B; 1.2c per engaged hour holds ($915M / 73.5B ≈ 1.24c).
Roblox infrastructure & trust-and-safety line per EDGAR-derived table: FY2023 ~$878M, FY2024 ~$915M, FY2025 ~$1,153M - fills the ledger's open question on FY2025 dollars.
A Q4 2025 summary describes the Sept 2025 DevEx rate change as an 8.5% increase, matching $0.0035 -> $0.0038; this dates the rise to Sept 2025, not Sept 2023 (resolves the open question).

Roblox 2026 guidance adds revenue $6.02-6.29B and FCF $1.60-1.82B; age-verification rollout is a mid-single-digit engagement and low-single-digit bookings headwind; margins flat to slightly down from higher DevEx rates and safety/infra spend.
Epic puts 50% of Sponsored Row (paid discovery, launched 24 Nov 2025) revenue into the engagement pool; the 100% V-Bucks-value window now runs to 31 Jan 2027.
Second Life LindeX percentage fee reportedly moves from 10% to 11% (second version of the June 2026 post) - this is the figure the ledger's open question asks about.

Rec Room headcount went ~310 -> 16% cut (Mar 2025) -> ~50% cut (Aug 2025) -> just over 100; Snap reportedly bought select assets and moved staff into Specs Inc.; creators stop earning 18 May 2026, token sales end 1 May 2026.
VRChat's Creator Economy Program Rules ($100 minimum, one payout per two weeks, up to 30 days) conflict with the payout page (30,000 credits, daily); Tilia is now branded Thunes.
Reality Labs has lost $83.6B cumulatively since 2020 on $11.8B revenue; the Horizon VR reversal covers only legacy Unity-engine worlds.

Method: all verdicts rest on WebSearch quoted extracts; page fetching was blocked. Not searched for budget reasons: ~1.04M Roblox daily paying users, full-year 2025 Roblox totals, Fortnite's 40% pool size, Rec Room's $294M raised, the Sandbox estate anecdote.
